name: 苏母
source: 《八零新婚夜，空间囤货养崽暴富》苏晚母亲

identity.en: A fifty-year-old Chinese peasant woman, early 1980s rural northern China
identity.text: 50 岁北方农村老太太，1980 年代初

face.en: Round wrinkled face, triangular eyes with downturned corners, thin lips pressed downward, sun-tanned skin, deep wrinkles on forehead and around mouth, weary disapproving expression
face.text: 满脸皱纹的圆脸，三角眼嘴角下撇，薄唇下压，黝黑皮肤，额头和嘴角皱纹深，神情疲惫不忿

hair.en: Grey-black hair pulled back into a tight bun at the nape, covered with a black hairnet, a few loose strands at the temples
hair.text: 灰白头发在后脑勺挽成发髻，罩黑网兜，鬓角散落几缕

top.en: A faded black homespun cotton crossed-collar tunic (dajin gua), cloth knot buttons along the right side, worn and thin at the elbows
top.text: 洗发黑粗布大襟褂子，右侧盘扣，肘部磨薄

bottom.en: Dark indigo coarse cotton trousers, grey cloth shoes with thin soles
bottom.text: 深靛蓝粗布裤，灰布鞋薄底

details.en: The grey bun held by a black hairnet, loose strands at the temples
details.text: 黑网兜罩着的灰白发髻，鬓角散发

details.en: The worn black crossed collar and cloth knot button
details.text: 磨旧黑大襟领口与盘扣

details.en: The thin worn black elbow patch

look.style: A real photograph, not a render: shot on a full-frame digital camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/5.6, natural true-to-life colors and white balance. Natural skin texture with the pores and fine lines the person's age calls for, a no-makeup look, no retouching, no beauty filter. Real fabric with natural creases. Subtle film grain.
look.clean: White seamless paper backdrop lit to pure white. A soft directional key light from the front-left with a weaker fill, so the face and clothes have gentle natural shadows and volume. Exactly one person, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: CGI, 3D render, digital painting, illustration, anime, airbrushed skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy skin, doll face, beauty filter, overly symmetrical face, oversharpened, HDR, glossy, over-saturated, flat lighting, porcelain skin, big anime eyes
